links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online health information on generalized pustular psoriasis (top 20 search results)
links.outcome: Readability indices and enhanced DISCERN reliability/quality scores after LLM rewording to a sixth-grade level (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Google Gemini)
links.effect: All LLMs significantly changed readability scores (p<0.01), reported as improved readability. All LLMs also scored lower on DISCERN than the original text (p<0.01).
links.tradeoff: The simplified texts lost reliability and quality relative to the original content, as measured by lower enhanced DISCERN scores.
links.quote: While LLMs improved readability, they did not preserve the original content's reliability and quality.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt for simplifying patient education content
